hook: Side hustle money comes with a tax most people never see coming.

blocks.narration: Side hustle money comes with a tax most people never see coming. It is called self-employment tax, and here is how it works.
blocks.visual: Bold poster-style orange and navy graphic of a laptop with coins spilling out, a shadowy hand reaching in

blocks.narration: At a regular job, your employer pays half of your Social Security and Medicare taxes. When you work for yourself, you pay both halves.
blocks.visual: Two halves of a coin slide together, one held by a company building, then both held by a single figure

blocks.narration: That combined rate is fifteen point three percent, and it applies to most of your net self-employment earnings, on top of income tax.
blocks.visual: A stack of coins with a bold slice cut out of it, the slice glowing orange

blocks.narration: On fifty thousand dollars of net profit, self-employment tax alone comes to roughly seven thousand dollars. Many people are shocked in April.
blocks.visual: A calendar flips to April and a large envelope slams onto a desk

blocks.narration: Nobody withholds it for you either. If you expect to owe one thousand dollars or more, the I R S expects quarterly estimated payments.
blocks.visual: Four bold calendar tiles light up one after another across the year

blocks.narration: Miss them and you may owe penalties and interest. A common habit is moving a share of every payment into a separate tax account.
blocks.visual: Each incoming coin splits, with one portion dropping into a locked jar

blocks.narration: Business expenses lower your net profit, which lowers this tax too. Track mileage, software, equipment, and a home office if it qualifies.
blocks.visual: Receipts fly into a neat folder as the cut-out slice of coins shrinks

blocks.narration: Plan for it now and April stays calm instead of scary. Follow before tax season sneaks up on you again.
blocks.visual: The figure relaxes in a chair as the April envelope arrives small and light

cta: Follow before tax season sneaks up on you.

captions.hook_line: Side hustle money comes with a 15.3% tax most people forget 🧾
captions.body: Self-employment tax is 15.3% (Social Security plus Medicare) on most net self-employment earnings, on top of income tax. On $50,000 of net profit that is roughly $7,000. If you expect to owe $1,000 or more, the IRS expects quarterly estimated payments. Not tax advice.
